description: Generate QR codes from text or URLs (PNG data URL or SVG)

error_correction.description: QR error-correction level: L, M (default), Q or H.

format.description: Output format: png (default, returned as a data URL) or svg (SVG markup); any other value returns png.

size.description: Image size in pixels (default 256, clamped to 64-1024).

name: qr-code
